The '''Albanin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] on the frontier of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], [[Blaudu Sextus]], [[Blaudu Octus]], [[Sim'char'ser]], [[Clantaano III]], and [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]].

==History==
Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of Albanin sector ordered the investigation that resulted in the end of safaris to hunt [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] incorrectly places the [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system]] in the Albanin sector, which is on the other side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
